text:
incident-bot: Pager: dedicated-resv-pool 'resv-eu-2' GPU utilization 98% · queue backlog rising >600 requests · autoscaler errors detected · severity: P1

Maya SRE: i'm on pager, joining bridge now. can someone paste the autoscaler logs?

Lucia Eng-SRE: seeing large spike in long-running sessions from tenant stellarnet — tons of pinned sessions with max_seq=4096. their reserved quota is hitting hard. CPU on nodes looks fine, GPU memory OOM-ish on several pods.

Jon Infra: autoscaler started scale-out at 14:12 UTC but CloudAPI returned 429/QuotasExceeded: "cannot create more instances". we hit the region VM quota for g5-type.

Priya Runtime: runtime reports continuous batching backlog growth; KV cache pressure high and evictions hitting tails. service-level throttles kicked in: 503 responses for new reservations.

Maya SRE: impact? which customers are seeing errors?

Ethan Support: Support dashboard — 3 enterprise customers (stellarnet, blueleaf, novahealth) reporting 5xxs on inference endpoints. Stellarnet is in the dedicated-capacity plan on resv-eu-2 — high impact. tickets open: #2459, #2460.

Lucia Eng-SRE: quick debug snippet:

```
# top problematic sessions (querying runtime admin API)
curl -s 'https://runtime-admin/api/v1/sessions?pool=resv-eu-2&state=running' | jq '.sessions | map({id, tenant, seq_len, runtime_ms}) | sort_by(-.runtime_ms) | .[:10]'
```

Lucia Eng-SRE: result: many stellarnet sessions with runtime_ms > 120000 and seq_len=4096. they're doing large-batch synchronous workloads.

Jon Infra: two mitigations options: 1) request quota bump from cloud (slow), 2) emergency borrow of non-prod reserved GPUs (resv-eu-staging) and temporarily reassign capacity to handle backlog. need approval for option 2.

Maya SRE: do we have RBAC + infra scripts to reassign? What's the risk?

Jon Infra: risk is small if we isolate by tenant tag. we can disable non-prod test workloads and repoint staging pool into dedicated-resv routing for 2 hours. will require a quick control-plane change + routing update.

Priya Runtime: alternative: enable per-tenant session preemption for stellarnet — kill their longest sessions to free up slots. that'll be noisy for them but fastest. we can also enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variant for non-enterprise traffic.

Maya SRE: propose stepwise: 1) attempt targeted preemption of sessions >90s and seq_len>2048 for stellarnet, 2) if backlog still >300, perform emergency-borrow from staging. 3) communicate to CS and affected customers.

Lucia Eng-SRE: executing preemption now. command: `./adminctl preempt-sessions --pool resv-eu-2 --tenant stellarnet --max-runtime-ms 90000 --min-seq 2048`

Ops-bot: action queued: preempt-sessions job started (job id: preempt-8821)

Priya Runtime: preempt job running — seeing ~38 sessions terminated, freeing ~12 GPUs worth of live allocation (approx). KV cache still heavy.

Maya SRE: backlog down from 620 -> 360 in 6 minutes. good sign but still above threshold.

Ethan Support: I told stellarnet that we are investigating and will provide ETA for mitigation in 15m. They asked if this will affect SLA — their legal contacts pinged CSM.

Jon Infra: autoscaler still failing due to quota. i'm starting the emergency-borrow procedure. disabling non-prod workloads on resv-eu-staging and rerouting traffic. will take ~8m to flip routing and ensure tag isolation.

Lucia Eng-SRE: note: need to ensure billing/reservation counters don't get confused — patch control-plane to mark borrowed nodes as 'ephemeral-borrow' so Dedicated accounting doesn't double-count.

Maya SRE: go for borrow. @Jon, @Lucia coordinate and call out if rollback needed.

Jon Infra: flipping routing now. commands: 
```
# reassign staging pool to ephemeral route
./infractl pool-assign --source resv-eu-staging --target resv-eu-2 --mode ephemeral-borrow --confirm
```

Ops-bot: pool-assign acknowledged, workflow wf-334 started

Priya Runtime: runtime sees new nodes join the pool — 10 GPUs added. queue backlog drops to 120 within 3 minutes. latency for in-flight requests returning to normal.

Maya SRE: great. what about noisy tenant behavior long-term?

Lucia Eng-SRE: follow-ups: 1) rate-limit stellarnet's session creation to 5 concurrent heavy sessions, 2) require stellarnet to move large-batch jobs to batch API (not reserved sync sessions), 3) work with sales/CS to review their contract if they require sustained peak.

Ethan Support: i've updated stellarnet ticket with mitigation steps and ETA. CSM is on a separate call and will coordinate next steps.

Maya SRE: post-incident next steps: create an incident ticket, schedule postmortem, request cloud quota increase for g5-region-eu, add autoscaler better error handling for QuotasExceeded (retry/backoff + fallback), and add preempt policies to default for dedicated pools.

Lucia Eng-SRE: filing incident now. brief description: "resv-eu-2 saturation due to stellarnet long-running sessions + autoscaler quota limit -> emergency borrow used to mitigate; customer-facing 5xxs for 2 enterprise customers; preemption and pool borrow reduced backlog and restored SLOs."

Maya SRE: final status: backlog reduced to 45, GPUs utilization ~72% after borrow, key customers responded that errors subsided. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. tagging @Priya to add runtime metrics + graphs to the incident doc.

Priya Runtime: adding metrics snapshot link: https://grafana.company/r/dash/7/resv-eu-2?from=1755550000&to=1755561600

Ethan Support: closing customer-facing updates for now. will re-open if they see regressions.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved -> mitigation applied: preemption + ephemeral-borrow; owners: eng-sre (Lucia), infra (Jon), runtime (Priya); follow-up: incident postmortem assigned (owner: Maya SRE)

Maya SRE: thanks team. will collect timelines and schedule RCA tomorrow.
